verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own design supports leaving. It is open source and self-hostable with Docker Compose and MongoDB, so you run the datastore yourself. Being warehouse-native, metric and event data stays in your own warehouse. Its full REST API, including the experiment results endpoint, lets you pull data out, and its OpenFeature docs state that switching away only requires changing the provider bootstrap. However, no dedicated bulk export of all flags, experiments and configuration in an open format is documented. missing for 10: a documented one-shot full-data export in open formats (JSON/CSV) covering flags, experiments and metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean migration off GrowthBook.
